decisive_items: A metal artifact reduction sequence MRI revealed a left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm, without bony involvement or bone‐marrow edema.
Hip aspiration yielded 10,750 white cells/μL; all cultures were negative.
response.rationale: The presence of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass and elevated inflammatory markers, despite negative cultures, suggests an adverse local tissue reaction rather than infection.

rejected.why: Initial diagnosis of bursitis does not explain the subsequent development of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass and persistent symptoms.
